model.prior: uniform over public catalog compatible with current species and revealed form, max four deterministic hypotheses; uncalibrated
model.history: filter through hard announced move list where safe; mutable item/ability disclosures are not treated as original facts
model.fallback: only a near-tied plain move/switch decision, without complex field/volatile/move effects; no coverage => preserve exact G421 action
model.surrogate: one-turn simultaneous bounded attack/switch damage/order model; no actual hidden state, no full Battle simulation or full equilibrium claim

primary: History minus G421 against AQ paired seed-block Student t 95% CI; analysis margin 0pt
secondary: History minus Prior against AQ, History minus G421 against Integrated Strategy, head-to-head History against G421; simultaneous Bonferroni family 95%
budget: Fixed 1024 new seed blocks x both seats x six matchups = 12288 completed four-win matches; excluded smoke seeds 430339001,430339002; no outcome-dependent seed omissions/extension; telemetry latency and completed games; no training or promotion
decision: Consider a separate confirmation only when the primary lower bound exceeds zero, the simultaneous Strategy lower bound exceeds -2 pp, direct win-rate lower bound exceeds 48%, and treatment made nonzero overrides. Otherwise HOLD.
latency: Record search wall-clock buckets for each gated turn on Ubuntu CI; hardware-dependent; no production timeout claim.
